_comment: English edition training and learning resources. Hand-checked: each URL was opened on 2026-11-06. This is a list of standing official resources, not a calendar of events; the English edition does not auto-collect events.

meta.title: Training and learning resources for hospital AI governance
meta.description: Official training and guidance resources from FDA, NIST and ONC that hospital administrators and IT teams use to learn about AI and HIPAA security.
meta.lead: There is no single official events calendar for hospital AI. Here are standing resources from official sources, each opened and checked.

notice: Standing resources, not scheduled events. Check each page for what it currently offers.

items.name: CDRH Learn
items.body: FDA’s training resource for the medical device center. Check the page for current modules.

items.name: NIST AI RMF Playbook
items.body: A companion resource to the AI Risk Management Framework with suggested actions for managing AI risk.

items.name: Implementing the HIPAA Security Rule (SP 800-66 Rev. 2)
items.body: A NIST publication on implementing the HIPAA Security Rule, useful for IT and compliance teams doing a risk analysis.

items.name: Information blocking resources
items.body: The federal health IT office’s materials on information blocking.
